briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.0% and S&P 500 down 1.1%, putting us in risk-off mode with no new candidates on the screened list. We're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing buys into a weak tape.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets (like growth and tech stocks) and move toward safety, causing indices like the NASDAQ to fall harder than more diversified ones like the S&P 500. On days like this, the smart move is often to hold existing positions and avoid chasing new buys until conditions stabilize.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off)是指投資人普遍拋售風險較高的資產(如成長股、科技股),轉向較安全的資產,這會導致納斯達克等指數的跌幅大於標普500等較分散的指數。在這種日子裡,較明智的做法通常是續抱現有部位,並避免追加新的買入,直到市況穩定下來。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based risk-off selling hit tech-heavy indices hardest today, with the NASDAQ's 2.0% decline outpacing the S&P 500's 1.1% drop, a pattern typical of growth-stock de-risking. No specific company headlines were available in today's screening data to pinpoint a single catalyst. The sharper NASDAQ decline suggests investors were rotating out of higher-beta, higher-valuation names relative to the broader market.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場呈現明顯的避險情緒,科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌2.0%,跌幅大於標普500指數的1.1%,顯示資金正從高估值、高波動的成長股撤離。今日篩選數據中並無具體的個股或總體經濟新聞可供引用作為明確導火線。納指跌幅較大的格局,反映投資人在避險時優先減碼風險較高的資產。
